scope: Independent script/plan/model narrative and mechanism review before voice production. Read all13 shots and independently recomputed the example SHA-derived positions and state traces.
coreRetelling: An application wants to avoid some catalog queries for missing product IDs. Fixed calculations make every ID address the same bits at insertion and lookup. Insertions only set bits to one, and multiple IDs can share them. Thus any still-zero position excludes a correctly inserted ID, whereas all ones can be marks left by other IDs and require the original catalog lookup. A smaller summary trades space for false-positive lookups; destructive clearing and unsynchronized new data invalidate safe rejection.
